tasks.subject: Task 1: Trie-free Unigram prefix search (patch-package)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Remove the 250k-piece `CharTrie` build from `@huggingface/tokenizers`' Unigram constructor, keeping tokenization byte-identical.

**Files:**
- Modify: `node_modules/@huggingface/tokenizers/dist/tokenizers.mjs`, `node_modules/@huggingface/tokenizers/dist/tokenizers.cjs`, captured as `patches/@huggingface+tokenizers+0.2.0.patch`
- Create: `scripts/hermes-tokenizer-parity.sh`
- Create: `scripts/bench-tokenizer.js`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `patches/@huggingface+tokenizers+0.2.0.patch` exists, and `npx patch-package --error-on-fail` applies it cleanly after `rm -rf node_modules/@huggingface/tokenizers && npm install --no-save @huggingface/tokenizers@0.2.0`. Simpler alternative: `npm ci`, then check the patched marker is present.
- [ ] Neither dist file calls `this.trie.extend(` any more. Both contain the marker comment `claim-check: trie-free unigram`.
- [ ] `npx jest src/engine/__tests__/tokenizer.test.ts src/engine/__tests__/text.test.ts` → all pass (267 tests), with no edits to those test files.
- [ ] `scripts/hermes-tokenizer-parity.sh` prints `hermes tokenizer parity: 82/82 match` and a `tokenizer ready in N ms` line.
- [ ] `node scripts/bench-tokenizer.js` prints construction ms and heap MB. Construction on Node from parsed JSON is ≤ 500 ms (baseline 1.2–1.8 s).

**Verify:** `npx jest src/engine/__tests__/tokenizer.test.ts src/engine/__tests__/text.test.ts && scripts/hermes-tokenizer-parity.sh && node scripts/bench-tokenizer.js`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["patches/@huggingface+tokenizers+0.2.0.patch", "scripts/hermes-tokenizer-parity.sh", "scripts/bench-tokenizer.js"], "verifyCommand": "npx jest src/engine/__tests__/tokenizer.test.ts src/engine/__tests__/text.test.ts && scripts/hermes-tokenizer-parity.sh && node --expose-gc scripts/bench-tokenizer.js", "acceptanceCriteria": ["patch file exists and applies via patch-package", "no this.trie.extend( in either dist file; marker comment present", "tokenizer + text Jest suites pass unmodified", "Hermes parity 82/82", "Node construction <= 500 ms"], "modelTier": "frontier"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Overlap ORT session creation with tokenizer loading
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `OnDeviceDecimaEngine.load` starts both `InferenceSession.create` calls before reading and building the tokenizer, so the native session work runs alongside the JS-thread work. Stage timings stay individually measured.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/engine/OnDeviceDecimaEngine.ts` (the `static async load(...)` method only)
- Modify: `src/engine/__tests__/engine.test.ts` (add one test)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] New test `load() starts both session creations before the tokenizer files are read` passes. It uses a fake `ort` and a fake `readText` that record call order, and does not need the model files.
- [ ] `encoderMs` / `scorerMs` measure from load start to each session's resolution. `readFilesMs`, `tokenizerParseMs` and `tokenizerMs` measure their own spans. `totalMs` is wall time from load start to return, so it is ≥ every individual stage.
- [ ] If either session creation rejects, `load()` rejects with that error, and no unhandled promise rejection is left behind.
- [ ] `npx jest` passes in full, and the parity line still reads `9.07e-8`.

**Verify:** `npx jest src/engine/__tests__/engine.test.ts` → all pass, including the new test.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/engine/OnDeviceDecimaEngine.ts", "src/engine/__tests__/engine.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npx jest src/engine/__tests__/engine.test.ts && npx tsc --noEmit -p .", "acceptanceCriteria": ["sessions created before tokenizer files are read (ordered-events test)", "per-stage timings measured independently; totalMs is wall time >= each stage", "load() rejects on session failure without unhandled rejection", "full jest suite passes with parity 9.07e-8"], "modelTier": "frontier"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Re-measure cold load on the emulator and record results
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Measure the patched build on the Android emulator with the existing protocol, and update `docs/phase0-results.md` with the before/after cold load, memory and parity.

**Files:**
- Modify: `docs/phase0-results.md` (Results table, per-thread table, question 5, conditions list)
- Create/overwrite: `results/device/run-{1,2,4}.log`, `results/device/meminfo-{1,2,4}.log` (generated)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `scripts/run-device-protocol.sh 1 2 4` completes, and `python3 scripts/summarize-device.py` prints a row for each thread count with tokenizer mismatches 0, max Δp 0.0154, and 0 order flips.
- [ ] The 2-thread cold load (`totalMs`) is reported against the ≤ 3 s target, with the stage breakdown. The doc records before (3.5–4.1 s) and after for every thread count.
- [ ] The doc reports the engine memory delta after the change (RSS/PSS before vs after load), next to the earlier ~0.32 GB.
- [ ] The doc says whether a fine-tune training run was using the host CPU/GPU during measurement (`pgrep -fl finetune`), because contention inflates emulator timings.

**Verify:** `scripts/run-device-protocol.sh 1 2 4 && python3 scripts/summarize-device.py`
